visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens inside a spacious, modern luxury apartment with white walls and a minimalist aesthetic. Large, multi-story windows fill the frame, showing a panoramic view of Seoul during sunset. To the left, a white staircase with a sleek black handrail descends into the room, and modern white orb-shaped light fixtures hang from the high ceiling. (2) The camera pans slowly across massive, curved floor-to-ceiling glass panels. Through the windows, the sky is a blend of blue, orange, and soft pink as the sun sets over distant mountains. The urban landscape of Seoul is visible below, featuring a high density of residential blocks and commercial buildings bathed in twilight. (3) The shot moves to show a large, square-shaped sunken sofa upholstered in light beige fabric, positioned in the center of the living area. The ceiling height is exceptionally high, creating a grand sense of space. A person's hand, wearing a silver ring, briefly enters the frame to point toward the soaring architectural dimensions and lighting fixtures. (4) The camera tilts downwards to look directly through the window at the Lotte World Adventure theme park located far below. The park's various rides, a central castle, and a lake are clearly visible from this high altitude. The surrounding city blocks are packed with white and grey buildings, highlighting the extreme height of the viewpoint.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 韓國最高住宅有多美？. [Subtitle]: 給大家看一下今天拍的豪宅. (2) [Subtitle]: 這個是曲面的落地窗. (3) [Subtitle]: 然後呢 還有一個降板沙發. (4) [Subtitle]: 這個樓高大概有七米 超級美. (5) [Subtitle]: 那我在哪裡呢？ 幫大家揭曉一下... [Variety]: 懼高症警告⚠️. (6) [Subtitle]: 我現在就在樂天塔上面. 你現在看到的就是樂天樂園.
